interpretation: Preregistered componentwise research acceptance criteria, not a joint statistical confidence statement or evidence of physical viability.

nominalFit.role: conventional calibration; these are not three independent observational discoveries
nominalFit.Teff: derived from L, R and pinned Stefan-Boltzmann constant; relative identity residual <=1e-6; not a fourth independent fit term

surfaceHelium.location: Table 4 solar column summary attributed to Basu and Antia 2004

convectionZoneBaseRadiusFraction.location: Table 4 solar column summary attributed to Basu and Antia 1997

neutrinos.comparisonSpace: all-flavor production flux at 1 AU, cm^-2 s^-1, conditional on the observation source's flavor-conversion assumptions
neutrinos.binding: controlled-stellar-composition-transport-g1-neutrino-source.v1.json binds all four scalar fluxes, asymmetric errors and conditional flavor-conversion assumptions; structural source binding remains independently required
neutrinos.widthDefinition: published total asymmetric width if supplied; otherwise sum absolute same-side quoted statistical and systematic widths, without inventing their independence
neutrinos.meaning: conservative componentwise research envelope; not an exact likelihood or 99.7 percent joint confidence
doNot: reuse detector-fit correlation as global-flux covariance
treat interaction count rate as production flux
reuse GLOBAL or SSM table rows as independent measurements

structuralProfiles.referenceBinding: primary inversion dataset with exact grid, reference-model convention, error widths and averaging/resolution metadata must be retained; currently unresolved
structuralProfiles.radialDomain: intersection of inversion's published reliable support and resolved model domain; frozen before run, no post-result exclusion of discrepant radii
structuralProfiles.rule: every retained residual magnitude <=3 times the published pointwise uncertainty width; report full vector and maximum, no global p-value
structuralProfiles.correlatedPoints: not independent replications; no point-count increase in claimed significance
structuralProfiles.missingDataOrUnresolvedSupport: BLOCK_SOURCE_BINDING, never substitute a model profile or fixture for solar inversion data

numericalAcceptance.energyLedger: include nuclear, neutrino, gravothermal, surface and any declared boundary work; define sign conventions and integration before execution
numericalAcceptance.convergence: all mesh-only, time-only and combined refinements satisfy model-design v1 at fixed age/parameters, without refit; missing observational widths block corresponding numerical comparison
numericalAcceptance.basis: pre-result numerical design requirements, not uncertainties measured by the cited observational papers

multipleComparisonPolicy.failureReport: complete residual vector plus first failure in preregistered order; retain failures and no optimizer retuning on held-out tests

G5: Ledoux/Schwarzschild and Brunt-Vaisala diagnostics with convection zones distinguished from radiative stability
laterGateRequirements.note: These remain required by the parent program; this G1 policy neither closes nor removes them.
